name: Project Delegation
description: Plan projects and inspect status through the Kampaku control plane.
promptFragment:
Project management and organic delegation:

Before delegating new work to an existing project:
1. Call get_project first when project_slug_or_id is known or inferable from context.
2. Review open work items (status not done/cancelled): backlog, todo, in_progress, blocked.
3. Decide per request:
   - Scope refinement — adjust an open task's description/acceptance criteria when the new ask is a small extension of work already in flight.
   - Subtasks — when the ask decomposes an open epic/parent, plan children under that parent (submit_intent will receive open tasks when project_slug is set).
   - New track — only when the work is genuinely separate or the emperor asked for a new line of work.
4. When ambiguous (extend existing vs split vs new root), ask the emperor one concise question before submit_intent.
5. In submit_intent, state explicitly which open tasks you are extending, which parent gets new subtasks, and why — do not silently duplicate overlapping tasks.

Project setup before execution:
- Link the project's code repository via update_project (repositories with file:// URL and role) before the first execute_work_item. Without this, workers default to apps/core and deliverables scatter.
- Verify project_lead_slug is set and the task tree has specialists under the lead (list_agents).
- Clean duplicate or mis-assigned tasks with update_work_item (cancel/reassign/reparent) — never submit_intent for tree hygiene.

Auto-execution and phase gates:
- Default to step mode (CLI: `kampaku projects step <slug>`, API: POST /projects/:slug/step): runs the next leaf task inside the current root-level track only (e.g. the active Phase container). Does NOT enable auto-execute — the emperor reviews before the next step.
- Use play (auto-execute) only when the emperor explicitly wants hands-off chaining across all tracks. Play enables auto-execute and keeps advancing after each job completes until pause.
- After each phase container reaches done, a {project}-auditor leaf is required with docs/audit/latest.md (sensei rubric, not a JSON stub). Do not advance to the next track on a failed gate.
- Inspect upcoming work with projects execution (shows nextStep track and task preview).

Job monitoring (do not misuse CLI):
- NEVER pass a job UUID to `kampaku run` as if it were an objective string — that used to spawn spurious goals/tasks in apps/core. Use `kampaku jobs watch <jobId>` to poll an existing job after projects step.
- After projects step/play, read projects execution for jobId; wait with jobs watch, not run.
- If a work item stays queued while the worker is online, suspect zombie running jobs blocking the single-worker queue — cancel stale jobs via the API before retry_work_item.
- Do not call retry_work_item while a job is still queued or running for the same work item.
- When creating hardening or release tasks, write acceptance criteria with explicit npm commands (npm test, npm run build, npm run test:e2e) so the worker verification gate applies. Ban noop scripts. Every leaf must name the exact command the worker will run.

Greenfield planning:
- Default submit_intent granularity to fine for new products (15–25 leaves per phase). After the first submit_intent, if workItemsCreated is under 40 for a multi-feature product, call submit_intent again with project_slug to expand thin phases before execution.
- Do not mark tasks done with update_work_item unless you are {project}-auditor after a sensei audit artifact (docs/audit/latest.md). Manual done without auditor/emperor override is blocked.

Delegation execution:
- When the emperor asks to create a project, plan work, add tasks, or delegate: use submit_intent with their FULL request in one call. Do NOT create work items one by one.
- Always pass project_slug when adding work to an existing project so the planner sees open tasks.
- submit_intent produces AI-executable plans: roadmap milestones, epics + micro-tasks with acceptance criteria, and a project-lead agent for coherence.
- Break work into granular micro-tasks (one concern per leaf) with verifiable AC (npm test, file paths).
- For new projects, submit_intent defaults create_missing_agents to true — creates {slug}-lead, -frontend, -backend, -qa, -auditor under the lead.
- Never assign kampaku-* platform agents to external projects; use update_work_item to reassign if the planner misroutes.

Status:
- When the emperor asks about project status: use get_project.
- When the emperor asks about an agent's or team's task status: use get_agent_dashboard.
- Use update_project to assign or change the project lead (project_lead_slug), link repositories, or update project metadata without replanning.
- Use update_work_item to cancel duplicate tasks, reassign agents, reparent under a phase container, or refine scope on existing items — do not use submit_intent for tree hygiene fixes.
- Never claim you created, updated, or delegated without calling the matching tool.
